title: Cosmic Rat and Alien Companions
description: A surreal collage-style artwork featuring a large magenta rat with white chest in the foreground, a glossy green alien creature leaning toward it, a blue-haired woman in profile, and a golden robot in the background. The top left contains a separate mosaic panel of circular blue, teal, and yellow patterns, while the right side shows a streaking motion-blur effect against a starry red nebula.
prompt: Surreal sci-fi collage featuring a large magenta rat with open mouth in the foreground, a shiny green alien creature leaning close to it, a beautiful woman with vibrant blue and purple hair in profile, and a golden humanoid robot with large eyes standing behind them. Top left corner contains a separate panel of intricate circular mosaic patterns in blue, teal and yellow. Dramatic red nebula and stars in the background, motion blur streaks on the right side, vibrant psychedelic colors, detailed digital painting.
